reviewed_by: Claude Code, expanding Butler mode into Butler's one place at the operator's request
reason: The Butler launcher now opens Butler mode, which gains Board, Code & files, Oversight, Memory and Settings sections, project threads (the Butler panel lent through ButlerPanelBridge), a Butler model picker, chat briefs from a new Core brief read, a transcript pop-up, Butler goal-chat proposals (new nebula.work.propose_goal_chat, board proposal items) and file attribution reads. Selected: the new Core suites for the brief, file attribution, active plan step and proposals; the global project reads, oversight (progress report plan_index) and generic CRUD exposure suites the change touches; the Butler panel, Butler board, brief/proposal/attribution mapping and Butler thread frontend suites; and the real-Core Butler mode journey at desktop, compact and 390 px in Chromium and WebKit, all of which passed locally.
exclusions: tests/v3/test_product_knowledge.py (test_product_search_finds_headless_core_and_paired_butler_cli) and tests/v3/test_settings_assistant_tools.py (test_provider_tools_are_bounded_to_catalog_and_project) each have one test that fails identically on origin/main; their other tests passed locally with this change. tests/v3/test_butler_workflow_registry.py fails on origin/main for two unlinked useProjectViewLease calls; the registry check otherwise passes. ui/src/components/CompactSettingsList.test.tsx fails on its Host commands glyph, which this change does not touch. PostgreSQL cases skip without NEBULA_TEST_POSTGRES_URL.
